title: The Largest Living Thing on Earth
hook: What if the biggest creature alive was hiding under a forest?
script: What if the biggest creature alive was hiding under a forest? It’s a single fungus, specifically the honey fungus, in Oregon. This organism stretches over 2,385 acres, a footprint larger than 1,600 football fields. It’s a single organism, estimated to be between 1,900 and 8,650 years old. The honey fungus spreads using black, shoelace-like threads, invading tree roots and choking them. Almost all of this giant lives underground as a web of threads, and most of it has never been seen by anyone.
